# runr_branding (Resource)

The white-label brand of the console, login page and e-mails (one per scope). Terraform owns the whole brand: attributes left out use RunR's defaults (for an organization: the install's brand), and destroying the resource resets the brand. Images can be set as URLs or `data:` URIs; uploads stay in the console.

`scope = "install"` is the installation's brand (`branding.manage`; multi-tenant: platform administrators), `scope = "organization"` an organization's own brand in the multi-tenant edition (`branding.manage` in the organization, while the platform allows organization brands).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The installation's brand. Attributes left out use the defaults; destroying the resource
# resets the brand.
resource "runr_branding" "brand" {
  product_name    = "Acme Cloud"
  company_name    = "Acme Corp."
  primary_color   = "#0f766e"
  accent_color    = "#f59e0b"
  login_headline  = "Welcome to Acme Cloud"
  support_email   = "support@acme.example"
  support_url     = "https://help.acme.example"
  email_from_name = "Acme Cloud"

  # Images as data: URIs from files next to the configuration (or https:// URLs).
  logo_light_url = "data:image/svg+xml;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/logo-light.svg")}"
  logo_dark_url  = "data:image/svg+xml;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/logo-dark.svg")}"
  favicon_url    = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/favicon.png")}"

  footer_links = [
    { label = "Status", url = "https://status.acme.example" },
    { label = "Privacy", url = "https://acme.example/privacy" },
  ]

  powered_by              = false
  tenant_branding_enabled = true # multi-tenant: organizations may set their own brand
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Accent colour (`#rrggbb`).
- `company_name` (String) Company name (footer, e-mails).
- `email_from_name` (String) Sender name of e-mails.
- `email_logo_url` (String) Logo of e-mails: an `https://` URL or a `data:` URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. An image uploaded in the console stays while this is unset.
- `favicon_url` (String) Favicon: an `https://` URL or a `data:` URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. An image uploaded in the console stays while this is unset.
- `footer_links` (Attributes List) Links of the console footer (at most 8). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--footer_links))
- `login_headline` (String) Headline of the login page.
- `login_text` (String) Text of the login page.
- `logo_dark_url` (String) Logo for dark backgrounds: an `https://` URL or a `data:` URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. An image uploaded in the console stays while this is unset.
- `logo_light_url` (String) Logo for light backgrounds: an `https://` URL or a `data:` URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. An image uploaded in the console stays while this is unset.
- `logo_mark_url` (String) Square logo mark: an `https://` URL or a `data:` URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. An image uploaded in the console stays while this is unset.
- `powered_by` (Boolean) Show "Powered by RunR" (install scope only).
- `primary_color` (String) Primary colour (`#rrggbb`).
- `product_name` (String) Product name shown in the console, the login page and e-mails.
- `scope` (String) `install` or `organization`. Default: `organization` for members of a multi-tenant installation who are not platform administrators, `install` otherwise.
- `support_email` (String) Support e-mail address.
- `support_url` (String) Support page (`https://…`).
- `tenant_branding_enabled` (Boolean) Allow organizations of a multi-tenant installation to set their own brand (install scope only). Unset: the switch stays as it is set in the console; destroying the resource keeps it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The scope.

### Nested Schema for `footer_links`

Required:

- `label` (String) Link text.
- `url` (String) `https://…`, `http://…` or `mailto:…`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# install (the installation's brand) or organization (multi-tenant: the organization's own brand)
terraform import runr_branding.brand install
```
